Equality of two radius-pair eigenvalue sums yields a root-of-unity polynomial P of degree<=p-1 with P(zeta)=0, P(1)=0, hence P is zero (since Phi_p is irreducible and P(1)=0), so precisely (p+1)(p+3)/8 distinct eigenvalues. A 4x2 contiguous rectangle resolves each eigenspace by nested x- and y-Vandermonde matrices (<=4 first-coordinate and <=2 second-coordinate frequencies). K time samples resolve the K distinct eigenvalues by temporal Vandermonde, proving exact full-signal recovery. All zero-radius, same-radius and zero-eigenvalue boundary cases covered. Independent modular Fourier block ranks for p=5,7,11,13 corroborate, not replace, the all-prime proof.
